newsitem.title: USA: First Pacific plans bankruptcy filing.
newsitem.headline: First Pacific plans bankruptcy filing.

text.p: First Pacific Networks Inc said it intends for file for voluntary bankruptcy protection and reorganization under Chapter 11 of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code.
The company said this action is being taken in an effort to return to financial stability.

As previously announced, the board is continuing to seek long-term financing and has directed management to evaluate all serious proposals with regard to the sale, acquisition or merger of the company as well as the sale or licensing of the company's proprietary technologies.
